The matching paper is GraDE: A Graph Diffusion Estimator for Frequent Subgraph Discovery in Neural Architectures by Yikang Yang, Zhengxin Yang, Minghao Luo, et al. [1] It proposes GraDE, a diffusion-guided search framework for frequent subgraph discovery, and says the estimator uses graph diffusion models to score subgraphs by typicality in the learned distribution [1].

It differs from the other results because those papers focus on discriminative subgraph mining, retrieval, reasoning, federated learning, recommendation, or graph pre-training rather than frequent subgraph discovery [2-10].
